criteria.text: NIP-86 pubkey and metadata methods require fully bound, fresh, single-use NIP-98 authorization from a persisted administrator.
ContextVM config/reconcile, config/status, and config/reload operate on managed relay targets.
A replacement relay runtime initializes before the active runtime stops, and initialization failure preserves service.
Legacy YAML seeding rejects read-only mounts with actionable guidance.
Signed trusted NIP-51 controller lists persist before hot application.
Desired config publication reaches durable application, signed status publication, and a cleared console drift view.
